standard.summary: 默认关闭。在预算内把部分冻结权重保留在 GPU，减少重复 CPU→GPU 搬运；与 latent、图像和文本数据缓存独立。
standard.effect: 启用缓存会占用额外显存；仅观察不分配手动缓存。不会缓存可训练的 LoRA 参数。
standard.whenToUse: 已使用分块、逐层或传统 swap 卸载，并愿意用少量显存减少权重搬运时开启。建议先设 256～512 MiB。
standard.avoidWhen: 显存余量不足时保持关闭或减小预算。搬运减少不保证训练更快。

standard_en.summary: Off by default. Keep some frozen weights on the GPU within a budget to reduce repeated CPU-to-GPU copies. Independent of latent, image and text data caches.
standard_en.effect: Caching uses extra VRAM; observe mode allocates no manual cache. Trainable LoRA parameters are excluded.
standard_en.whenToUse: Enable with a supported block, layer or swap offloader when spare VRAM is available. Start with 256–512 MiB.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Keep off or reduce the budget when VRAM is tight. Fewer copies do not guarantee faster training.

advanced.principle: MOSS、Krea2 等分块卸载复用同一控制器；Krea2 支持逐层缓存，传统 swap 支持冻结 Linear/Conv2d。新接线仅选择普通 FP16/BF16/FP32 冻结参数；特殊量化格式继续原卸载。Anima、Newbie 和 Native SDXL 保留已有缓存路径。
advanced.tradeoffs: 当前按显式预算静态选择，不是动态 I/O 预测。运行报告包含实际缓存量、选中层和命中次数。

advanced_en.principle: Shared block offload, Krea2 layer offload and traditional Linear/Conv2d swap use the same planner. New adapters select plain frozen FP16/BF16/FP32 parameters; specialized quantized formats keep their existing path. Anima, Newbie and native SDXL retain their existing caches.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: Selection is static within the explicit budget, not dynamic I/O prediction. Runtime reports include actual bytes, selected layers and hits.
